title: Keep It Quiet
text: A privacy scare forces you to slow down and tighten routines.

title: Old-Head Advice
text: A trusted mentor shares hard-earned lessons.

title: Supply Run
text: Scarce equipment costs more than expected.

mitigation.label: Your existing gear softened the shortage.

title: Keeper Found
text: A standout plant earns attention and a place in your notes.

title: Community Favor
text: You help another grower and the relationship comes back around.

title: Make It Work
text: Improvisation keeps the project moving, but it costs time.

mitigation.label: Knowledge turned the workaround into a clean solution.

title: Patient Referral
text: Reliable results bring a patient-focused referral.

title: Paper Trail
text: New documentation expectations expose weak record keeping.

title: Testing Day
text: Testing gives you useful feedback on consistency.

title: Co-op Opportunity
text: A small collaboration opens access to better tools.

title: Rules Shift
text: A fast policy change creates extra work.

mitigation.label: Compliance readiness keeps the change manageable.

title: Training Session
text: A formal workshop upgrades your process.

title: Brand Partnership
text: A compatible partner expands your reach.

mitigation.label: Strong reputation makes the partnership more valuable.

title: Market Compression
text: Crowded shelves pressure margins.

mitigation.label: A recognizable brand protects part of your demand.

title: Compliance Review
text: A routine review tests how professional the operation has become.

mitigation.label: Clean records turn the review into a confidence boost.

title: Scale Decision
text: A measured expansion creates more productive capacity.

title: Community Recognition
text: Years of documented work earn public recognition.

title: Teach the Next Grower
text: Sharing what you learned strengthens the legacy beyond your own operation.

title: Tool Swap
text: A trusted grower trades spare equipment for help on a weekend project.

mitigation.label: Your know-how made the trade more valuable.

title: Dry Spell
text: A slow stretch forces you to stretch supplies and rethink priorities.

mitigation.label: Simple routines kept the slowdown from becoming a setback.

title: Notebook Breakthrough
text: Careful notes reveal a pattern you had been missing.

title: Lab Delay
text: A testing delay ties up time and cash while the schedule slips.

mitigation.label: Complete records kept the delay contained.

title: Patient Feedback
text: Consistent feedback helps sharpen priorities and earns trust.

title: Process Upgrade
text: A small workflow improvement saves repeated effort across the operation.

mitigation.label: Existing equipment made the upgrade cheaper.

title: Retailer Meeting
text: A retailer gives you a narrow opportunity to prove the brand can perform.

mitigation.label: A clear identity turns the meeting into repeat interest.

title: Equipment Failure
text: A production interruption tests whether the operation can absorb downtime.

mitigation.label: Redundant equipment keeps most of the operation moving.

title: Team Training
text: Structured training makes the operation more consistent and easier to scale.
